# The check applies the rules of the run to literal arguments, so a workflow with two bad literals fails the check and not the run.
isolate

! exec obeereal check workflow bad.star
stderr 'agent: output_tries must be a whole number of 1 or more'
stderr 'command: timeout is "soon", which is not a duration'

-- bad.star --
def main(item):
    agent("p", "m", output_tries = 0)
    command(run = ["x"], timeout = "soon")
